title: Canon of the Kindled Bolt
summary: Joins the thunder stream to a second stream of fire so that the bolt burns as it strikes.

title: Book of the Riding Arc
summary: Joins the thunder stream to a second stream of wind so that the arc rides the air to its mark.

title: Treatise of the Grounded Thunder
summary: Joins the thunder stream to a second stream of earth, an opposed pairing in which the bolt is anchored in the ground.

title: Canon of the Mind and the Arc
summary: Joins the thunder stream to the soul so that the arc strikes the spirit of a foe along with the body.
